content: Jesus Thawkikna
Sabbath ni a bo ciang in, Mary Magdalene, James nu Mary le Salome te hongpai uh a, Jesus luanghawm zut tu sathau namtui te keng uh hi.
Nipikal khat sung ni masabel ni zingtung, ni sua ciang in, amate than ah pai uh hi.
Taciang amate in than kongkha a suangtum sia kua in hong liksak tu ziam? ci in kikum kawm uh hi.
Amate in a et uh ciang in, suangtum a ki lik sa in mu uh hi: banghangziam cile tua suangtum sia lian mama hi.
Than sung a tum uh ciang in, tangval khat puanpak tualpui sil in ziatsang ah a to, amate in mu uh a; lau mama uh hi.
Ama in numei te kungah, lau heak vun: thinglamte tung a ki khai Nazareth khua mi Jesus zong nu hi; Ama thokik zo hi; hi mun ah om nawn ngawl hi: Ama ki vui na hong en tavun.
Ahihang pai tavun a, a nungzui te le Peter kungah, na mai uh Galilee ah pai hi, ci in son vun: note hong sonkholsa bangma in, tua mun ah mu tu nu hi, ci in son hi.

Taciang amate than pan in manlangtak in pai uh a, tai kawm uh hi; banghangziam cile amate huang liang in lamdangsa mama uh hi: kuama kungah zong bangma son ngawl hi; banghangziam cile amate a lau uh hang a hihi.
Jesus Mary Magdalene Kung ah Kilang
Jesus sia nipikal khat sung ni masabel ni zingtung a thawkik ciang in, a sung pan doai ngilo sali a hawlkhiatsak Mary Magdalene kungah kilang masabel hi.
Taciang ama pai a, Jesus taw kithawl ngei in, a kap a tau te son hi.
Amate in, Jesus nungta hi, ci le Mary in mu hi, ci a zak uh ciang in, a um bua uh hi.
Jesus Nungzui Ni te Kung Kilang
Tuazawkciang in amate sung pan mi ni, khuano sang a pai te kungah, Jesus meal lamdang in kilaak hi.
Taciang amate pai in a dang te son a hi uh hang: amate in a um bua uh hi.
Nasep Lianbel Apna

Tuazawkciang in, nungzui sawm le khat te anneakna mun ah a to uh laitak, Jesus hong kilang a, amate tei hi, banghangziam cile amate in a thawkik zawk a mu te i son te um ngawl in a thinpui uh hang a hihi.
Jesus in amate tung ah,

content.text: Note leitung theampo ah pai tavun a, piansakna theampo tungah lungdamna thu son tavun.
Um in tuiphumna a sang peuma ngupna nga tu hi; ahihang a um ngawl te sia thukhenna thuak tu hi.
A umte sia hibang musakna te in zui tu hi; ka min taw doai te hawlkhia tu uh a; kam thak taw pau tu uh hi;
Ngul te zong man tu uh a; ngu a ne hial uh zong, bangma tat ngawl tu hi; cina te tungah a khut uh te nga tu uh a, dam tu hi,

content: Jesus Van ah Kato
Topa in amate thu a son zawkciang in, Ama sia van ah ki la to a, Pathian ziatsang ah to hi.
Amate pai uh a, mun theampo ah thuhil uh hi, Topa amate taw naseam a, a thuhilna uh te nalamdang te in zui in kipsak hi. Amen.
